McDonald's Collection 2011 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Other series, released in English on June 17, 2011. It has 12 cards. It includes 12 Pokémon, 0 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).
